equip_empty: Bag is empty. Clear stages to loot gear.

equip_t2_desc: Authority to move troops. ATK & HP +5%.
equip_t3_desc: Sunzi's classic. ATK & HP +6%, deploy CD -0.2s.
equip_t4_desc: Cao Cao's notes. ATK & HP +8%, deploy CD -0.35s.
equip_t5_desc: Secret lore. ATK & HP +10%, deploy CD -0.5s.
main_all_clear: All twelve stages secured. New chapters await.
select_tip: Recruit Lu Su or Xun Yu for grain, then hold lanes with Ding Feng, Sun Shangxiang and others
battle_hint_select: Pick a card, then deploy on the field
battle_hint_place: Tap the field to deploy · right click to cancel
battle_hint_retreat: Tap a deployed unit to withdraw it
help_goal: [Goal] Enemies march from the right in waves. Hold the gate with your generals' talents. The gate starts at 5 HP; when it hits 0 you lose (a boss breach costs 5).
help_controls: [Controls] 1) Pick a card on the left, then tap an empty tile to deploy. Cards have cooldown and food cost. 2) With Dismiss active, tap a deployed general to retire it and refund 60% food. 3) Advisor buys one-off tactics, How-to opens this page, SFX toggles sound, Pause offers restart or quit.
help_terms: [Terms] Food = deploy resource; kills and supply units loot extra. Combo = 3 kills within 2.5s grants bonus food. Barricade = one row clear per lane, followed by brief gate invulnerability. Bond = specific generals together gain buffs. Equipment = stage loot that boosts stats.
strat_hint: Fire / Hold / Slow - each usable once per battle
story_tut_1: Beacon smoke rises. The northern horde bears down on the lone city, and the gate may fall at any hour.
story_tut_2: At the darkest hour, an old general steps forward — Ding Feng of Wu, famed for fighting bare-blade in the snow.
story_tut_3: I am Ding Feng, styled Chengyuan! Hearing this city is in peril, I came at once.
story_tut_4: My blade takes only the enemies straight ahead, and it never misses — give me one lane and it will hold!
story_tut_5: [General Gained] Ding Feng joins your camp!
story_lusu_1: The first wave is swept away. The gate breathes again, and the people bring food to the defenders.
story_lusu_2: A scholar arrives with grain carts — Lu Su of Linhuai, styled Zijing, a man of great generosity.
story_lusu_3: I have heard of this city's loyalty. Let me open my granaries for it — a thousand deaths, no regret!
story_lusu_4: [General Gained] Lu Su joins your camp! +50 food every 25 seconds.
story_xq_1: The second wave is also beaten back. At night the drums fade, and a clear flute drifts across the water.
story_xq_2: A lady in crimson stands with a flute — Xiao Qiao of Jiangdong, who crossed the river to help.
story_xq_3: My notes freeze the bone. Let my Frost Beauty slow them, and you shall break them at leisure!
story_xq_4: [General Gained] Xiao Qiao joins your camp! Her frost slows swarming enemies.
result_lose_tip: Enemies broke through. Rebuild your line and try again.
guide_collect: Tap falling grain to collect it. Grain fuels everything.
guide_plant_peach: Recruit Lu Su first — he keeps sending grain.
guide_plant_archer: Now deploy Ding Feng. His blade strikes down his own lane.
guide_ready: The line is set. Await the Yellow Turbans.
guide_step2: 1) Deploy: tap the 'Ding Feng' card, then an empty tile
guide_step3: 2) Hold: enemies are coming! Ding Feng strikes as soon as he lands
guide_step4: 3) Economy: Lu Su yields +50 food every 25s — place him in the rear
guide_step5: 4) Block: enemies gang up on your generals and wear them down — hold!
guide_step6: 5) Slow: Xiao Qiao slows by 50% — place her right behind Ding Feng
guide_step7: Hold this wave! Watch the gate HP and wave counter — survive to finish
guide_lock_one: Tutorial: only "%{0}" can be chosen now
guide_lock_none: Tutorial: just watch this wave, no deployment needed
unit_zhangfei_desc: Every 6s, a roar knocks back enemies within 2 tiles (1.25 tiles) and deals damage.
unit_zhugeliang_desc: Every 8s, lays a 3x3 Eight Trigrams array on the nearest enemy; enemies inside are slowed 50%.
unit_dingfeng_desc: Every 1.4s thrusts down its lane, hitting the first enemy only.
unit_lusu_desc: Never attacks. Every 25s sends grain, +50 food — the backbone of your economy.
unit_xiaoqiao_desc: Frost wave down its lane, slowing the first enemy by 50% for 2.5s.
unit_juma_desc: Never attacks. Enormous HP barricade that blocks its lane forever.
unit_sunshangxiang_desc: Twin crossbows fire two blades down the lane every 1.4s.
unit_taishici_desc: Three-bow volley: one arrow each to its lane and the two adjacent lanes.
unit_huanggai_desc: After 7s, self-immolates to scorch a 3x3 area, then perishes.
unit_wutugu_desc: Spiked caltrops guard the lane; attackers take thorn damage on every bite.
unit_luxun_desc: Fire sweeps the whole lane, burning every enemy and consuming itself.
unit_xuchu_desc: Leaps at the enemy ahead, crushing it with one blow before shattering itself.
unit_ganing_desc: Every 18s, devours the enemy ahead for massive damage, then chews for a long while.
unit_mengdai_desc: Hurls a returning dart every 1.6s that pierces every enemy in its lane.
unit_huangyueying_desc: Lobs machinery in an arc, splashing damage around the landing point.
unit_xunyu_desc: Every 18s sends grain, +35 food. Faster but smaller than Lu Su.
unit_zhangliao_desc: Every 10s, sweeps the whole field, damaging and slowing all enemies by 50% for 3s.
unit_simayi_desc: Every 8s, thunder strikes its lane plus both adjacent lanes.
unit_caocao_desc: Every 15s, rallies all allies: +25% attack for 6s. Stacks.
unit_zhenji_desc: Every 18s, Luo River heals all allies for 15% HP and grants 20% damage reduction for 5s.
unit_jiangwei_desc: Sets an ambush in its lane; the first enemy to step in is mauled.
unit_pangtong_desc: Once per battle, revives on death at 50% HP and scorches nearby enemies.
unit_dongzhuo_desc: Detonates in fury, blasting a 3x3 area before perishing.
enemy_minfu_desc: Grain porter with no combat value; killing it loots +8 food.
enemy_yibing_desc: Hastily drafted rabble with low morale, but numerous.
enemy_tuntian_desc: Farms and fights; poorly trained but steadier than rabble.
enemy_gongcheng_desc: Army craftsman digging trenches as he advances. Weak in melee.
enemy_zijun_desc: 850 HP wagon that never bites, only pushes; killing it loots +30 food.
enemy_houqi_desc: Extremely fast infiltrator that drops in from inside the field.
enemy_inf_desc: The most common enemy, marching in squads as the backbone of every wave.
enemy_gongjian_desc: Ranged harasser, fragile up close; advances as melee here.
enemy_nubing_desc: Repeating crossbow that suppresses its lane while marching.
enemy_changqiang_desc: Roadblock armor (-30% damage taken); spear wall counters cavalry.
enemy_shield_desc: Iron gate armor (-40% damage taken); tough from the front, weak to fire.
enemy_iron_desc: Iron bucket armor (-50% damage taken); fears sustained ranged fire.
enemy_cav_desc: Highly mobile; leaps over the first blocker to flank.
enemy_arch_desc: Horse archer that leaps the first blocker and pushes fast.
enemy_pole_desc: Climbs over the first blocker and keeps charging.
enemy_shanyue_desc: Jungle leaper; leaps the first blocker and takes -20% damage.
enemy_zhongqi_desc: Charge breaker with a brutal first hit; -30% damage taken, fears spears and traps.
enemy_boss_desc: Stage boss with far higher HP and damage. Felling it decides the battle.
